_documentation.purpose: Configuration for iganet_lin_elasticity_3D_multipatch_parametrized.cxx (LBFGS-trained IgANet multipatch example, supports per-patch boundary conditions via patches_3d).
notes: geometry.mode can be 'xml' (loads multipatch_xml_path) or 'parametric' (built procedurally in code).
geometry_spline and solution_spline must match (isoparametric solution space).
patches_3d sets per-patch Dirichlet (diri_sides) and traction (force_sides) boundary conditions, addressed by each patch's xml_id.
simulation.min_loss/min_loss_change/min_loss_rel_change from the IgANet core are hardcoded to (near-)disabled in this example; simulation.max_epoch is the only effective stopping criterion.
